about: The vocabulary audit's allowlist (scripts/vocab-audit.ts, U21.3): files that are not screen text, and retired words that may stay where they are, each with its reason. An entry matches a hit by file (relative to src/), alias and the literal's whole visible text (white space collapsed, an interpolation read as " … ") — never a substring, so a new sentence in the same file is audited; an entry no hit matches fails the audit.
